activities.activity_description: Design, implement, and test the flexible RxJava module to function as a processor within the Spring application context (U1).
Conduct a spike to review customer use cases, define design specs for ACLs, identify the best approach for XD runtime, scope DSL and UI, and document next steps (U2).
Profile the admin and container servers to identify high CPU startup bottlenecks, document reasons, and list pros/cons of potential solutions (U3).
Implement the option to store, read, and reinstall the custom module uber-jar in HDFS, leveraging HA features for failure scenarios (U4/U5).
Implement configuration properties allowing users to override the HDFS location for storing and retrieving the custom module uber-jar (U6).
Implement configuration properties allowing users to override the YARN config location for storing and retrieving the custom module uber-jar (U7).
Implement the functionality to stop an existing Spark job to clean up resources upon completion (U8).
Perform end-to-end integration testing of all new features, ensuring they work together correctly within the Spring application context.
